create_BasicBlockBN: create a BasicBlockBN MinkowskiEngine residual block with batch normalization for sparse 3D convolutions
create_BasicBlockIN: create a BasicBlockIN MinkowskiEngine residual block with instance normalization for sparse 3D convolutions
build_get_block: build a residual block using get_block with a specified norm type BN or IN
review_BasicBlockBase_forward: review the BasicBlockBase forward pass that applies conv norm relu and residual addition
refactor_BasicBlockBase: refactor the BasicBlockBase class to support a new normalization type beyond BN and IN
